writing.directions: Suppose your university is seeking students' opinions on the necessity of making College Chinese a compulsory course. You are now to write an essay to express your view. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
writing.model: The question of whether College Chinese should be a compulsory course has sparked heated discussion on campus. In my view, making it compulsory is both necessary and wise. Admittedly, some students argue that Chinese is their mother tongue and needs no further study. Yet this view overlooks two facts. First, a solid command of Chinese sharpens our thinking and expression. Many science majors write reports full of grammatical errors and muddled logic, which weakens their careers. A required course would help them communicate clearly. What's more, classical Chinese carries our cultural heritage. Through reading poems and essays, students inherit values and a sense of identity that no other subject offers. Therefore, I firmly believe College Chinese deserves a place as a compulsory course. It is not a burden but an investment in both our language ability and our cultural roots.
writing.modelZh: 【参考译文】大学语文是否应设为一门必修课，在校园里引发了热烈讨论。在我看来，把它设为必修既必要又明智。诚然，有些学生认为中文是母语，无需再学。然而这种看法忽视了两点事实。第一，扎实的中文功底能磨练我们的思维与表达。许多理工科学生写出的报告满是语法错误、逻辑混乱，这会拖累他们的职业发展。一门必修课能帮助他们清晰地沟通。此外，古典中文承载着我们的文化遗产。通过阅读诗文，学生得以传承价值观与身份认同，这是任何其他学科都给不了的。因此，我坚信大学语文理应占据一门必修课的位置。它不是负担，而是对我们语言能力与文化根脉的一项投资。【第 1 段】一句背景一句立场。首段落实了『首段：一句背景一句立场』：第一句 The question of

outline.text: 一句背景一句立场。首段落实了『首段：一句背景一句立场』：第一句 The question of whether College Chinese should be a compulsory course has sparked heated discussion 用套架点 出争议背景；第二句 In my view, making it compulsory is both necessary and wise 立刻亮明赞成立 场，开头就让阅卷人看清你选哪边。

让步—观点—例证—小结落地。主体段先用 Admittedly, some students argue... Yet this view overlooks 让步再反驳；再用 First 与 What's more 分领两条理由；每条都配例子——理工科学生 write reports full of grammatical errors and muddled logic、classical Chinese carries our cultural heritage，做到了不空喊口号。
连接词重申再升华。尾段用 Therefore 领起，Therefore, I firmly believe College Chinese deserves a place 换句重申立场；末句 It is not a burden but an investment 用『不是A而是B』把意义 拔高，首尾呼应、没有引入新理由。

translation.directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to translate a passage from Chinese into English. You should write your answer on Answer Sheet 2.
translation.source: 被誉为"杂交水稻(hybrid rice)之父"的袁隆平和他的科研团队克服重重困难,研发出了一种超级杂交水稻。这项技术获得了举世公认的巨大成功。通过这项技术的应用,水稻抗旱抗病能力更强,能适应不同的气候和土壤条件,产量可提高20-30%。超级杂交水稻营养丰富,口感更佳。目前,这项技术已经在许多国家得到广泛应用,为全球粮食安全做出了重大贡献。
translation.reference: Yuan Longping, known as the father of hybrid rice, and his research team, overcoming numerous difficulties, developed a super hybrid rice. This technology has achieved great success recognized worldwide. With the application of this technology, the rice has stronger resistance to drought and disease and can adapt to different climates and soil conditions, and its yield can increase by 20 to 30 percent. In addition, super hybrid rice is rich in nutrition and tastes better. Currently, this technology has been widely applied in many countries, making great contributions to global food security.

sentences.trunk: 主干 = 袁隆平和团队 + 研发出 + 超级杂交水稻（主语策略：原句主语） 中文核心动词是 研发出了一种超级杂交水稻，所以谓语取 developed，宾语 a super hybrid rice；主语是动作发出者 袁隆平和他的科研团队→Yuan Longping and his research team。中文 里「克服重重困难」也是个动词短语，但它从属于「研发」这个主事件，不该和它并列成第二个主 干谓语。
sentences.downgrade: 誉称降为定语、克服困难降为状语 把主干之外两块各自降级：① 被誉为"杂交水稻(hybrid rice)之父"的是修饰袁隆平的，降成过去分 词后置定语 known as the father of hybrid rice，紧贴 Yuan Longping；② 克服重重困难是「研 发」的伴随/方式，降成现在分词短语 overcoming numerous difficulties 作状语，挂在主句后。 这样一个主句带一个定语、一个状语，不再是三个动词平铺。
sentences.grammar: 时态 研发出是已完成的历史动作，偏离全篇现在时基调，用一般过去时 developed。研发出了的「了」 也提示动作已完成。 语态 「被誉为」是被动，但降级成定语后用过去分词 known as 表被动含义，无需写成完整被动从句 who is known as。 单复数与冠词 一种超级杂交水稻的「一种」→不定冠词 a，a super hybrid rice；father 作独一无二的称号，前 加定冠词 the father of hybrid rice。 搭配 「克服困难」固定搭配 overcome difficulties；「重重困难」用 numerous / many difficulties， 不要逐字译成 heavy difficulties。
sentences.target: Yuan Longping, known as the father of hybrid rice, and his research team, overcoming numerous difficulties, developed a super hybrid rice. 2. 这项技术获得了举世公认的巨大成功。

sentences.trunk: 主干 = 这项技术 + 获得 + 巨大成功（主语策略：原句主语） 主语 这项技术→This technology，承接上句的超级杂交水稻；谓语 获得了→has achieved / achieved；宾语 巨大成功→great success。
sentences.downgrade: 举世公认降为定语修饰 success 举世公认的是修饰「成功」的，降成形容词作前置定语 worldwide-recognized success，或用 recognized worldwide 后置；本句结构简单，主干立好后只需把这一个修饰语挂到 success 上 即可。
sentences.grammar: 时态 「获得成功」是已取得并延续至今的结果，宜用现在完成时 has achieved，强调对现在的影响；用 一般过去时 achieved 亦可。这是合理偏离现在时基调的一处。 主谓一致 主语 This technology 是单数第三人称，完成时助动词用 has 不用 have。 单复数与冠词 success 在此表「一次成功（成就）」可数化，配 a great success；若视作抽象不可数则用 great success 不加冠词，二者均可，但需自洽。
sentences.target: This technology has achieved great success recognized worldwide. 3. 通过这项技术的应用,水稻抗旱抗病能力更强,能适应不同的气候和土壤条件,产量可提高 20-30%。

sentences.trunk: 主干 = 水稻 + 抗旱抗病力更强（并列三个谓语）（主语策略：原句主语） 这句信息多，主语是 水稻→the rice，三个并列陈述共享它：抗旱抗病能力更强（has stronger resistance）、能适应不同的气候和土壤条件（can adapt to…）、产量可提高20-30%（其 yield can increase…）。主干先立「the rice has stronger resistance to drought and disease」。
sentences.downgrade: 状语前置 + 并列谓语 + 产量另起小主语 把三块安放好：① 通过这项技术的应用是方式状语，前置成 With the application of this technology；② 「抗旱抗病更强」「能适应气候土壤」两块同主语 the rice，用 and 连成并列谓 语 has stronger resistance… and can adapt to…；③ 产量可提高20-30%主语变成「产量」而非 「水稻」，单独起一个小分句 its yield can increase by 20 to 30 percent，用 and 接上或分号隔 开，避免和前面强行共用主语。
sentences.grammar: 时态 全句陈述技术带来的当前普遍效果，回指全篇基调用一般现在时：has、can adapt、can increase。 单复数与冠词 不同的气候和土壤条件→different climates and soil conditions，conditions 用复数表「各种条 件」；抗病的「病」泛指各类病害，disease 用不可数或 diseases 均可。 数字与百分比 产量可提高20-30%译为 increase by 20 to 30 percent。提高「幅度」用 increase by（不是 increase to「提高到」）；20-30% 写成 20 to 30 percent 或 20%-30%，区间用 to 连接。 搭配 「抗……能力」用 resistance to drought and disease（resistance 后接 to）；「适应……条件」 用 adapt to conditions。
sentences.target: With the application of this technology, the rice has stronger resistance to drought and disease and can adapt to different climates and soil conditions, and its yield can increase by 20 to 30 percent. 4. 超级杂交水稻营养丰富,口感更佳。

sentences.trunk: 主干 = 超级杂交水稻 + is rich in nutrition + tastes better（主语策略：原句主语） 主语 超级杂交水稻→Super hybrid rice（或承接上文用 It）；两个并列陈述：营养丰富→is rich in nutrition / nutritious，口感更佳→tastes better。
sentences.downgrade: 两个并列表语用 and 连接 本句结构简单，两个陈述同主语，直接用 and 并成 is nutritious and tastes better 即可，无需进 一步降级。点明即可。
sentences.grammar: 时态 陈述水稻当前固有特性，用一般现在时 is、tastes，回指全篇基调。 主谓一致与第三人称单数 Super hybrid rice 视作不可数/单数，谓语 tastes 加 -s（第三人称单数），别漏掉这个 s。 搭配 「营养丰富」用 be rich in nutrition 或形容词 nutritious；「口感更佳」用 taste better，taste 此处是连系动词后接形容词 better，不用 well。
sentences.target: Super hybrid rice is rich in nutrition and tastes better. 5. 目前,这项技术已经在许多国家得到广泛应用,为全球粮食安全做出了重大贡献。

sentences.trunk: 主干 = 这项技术 + has been widely applied（被动）（主语策略：转被动） 这项技术已经在许多国家得到广泛应用中，技术是被「应用」的承受者，「得到广泛应用」本身就 是被动语义→主语 This technology，谓语转被动 has been widely applied。后半 为全球粮食安 全做出了重大贡献主语仍是这项技术（主动），并列接上。
sentences.downgrade: 时间状语前置 + 被动主句 + 贡献作并列谓语 三块安放：① 目前时间状语前置 Currently / At present；② 被动主句 this technology has been widely applied in many countries；③ 为全球粮食安全做出了重大贡献与主句同主语，用 and 并成并列谓语 and has made great contributions to global food security，或改用现在分 词 making great contributions… 作结果状语，更显「应用→带来贡献」的因果。
sentences.grammar: 时态 目前+已经提示动作完成并延续到现在，用现在完成时：has been applied、has made。这是合 理偏离现在时基调处。 语态 「得到广泛应用」用被动 has been widely applied；副词 widely 放在 been 与 applied 之间。 搭配 「做出贡献」固定搭配 make a contribution / make contributions to sth；contribution 后接 to + 名词（to food security），别用 for。 术语 全球粮食安全→global food security，务必是 food security（粮食供给安全）不是 food safety （食品卫生安全）。
sentences.target: Currently, this technology has been widely applied in many countries, making great contributions to global food security. 英语四级 2025年6月·第1套 · 全卷构成 Part I 写作 题目解析 → Part II 听力 题目解析 → Part Ⅲ Section A 完形填空（选词填空） 题目解析 → Part Ⅲ Section B 长篇阅读（信息匹配） 题目解析 → Part Ⅲ Section C (1) 阅读理解（四选一） 题目解析 → Part Ⅲ Section C (2) 阅读理解（四选一） 题目解析 → Part IV 汉译英（段落翻译） 本题

questions.stem: What does the news report say about Vaclav Bursa and Joanna Stephens?
questions.stemZh: 新闻报道中关于Vaclav Bursa和Joanna Stephens说了什么?
questions.answerText: They won this year's 7 Mile Bridge Run.

explain.定位: Vaclav Bursa, 15, of Big Pine Key, Florida, finished first overall. ... Joanna Stephens, 28, of Atlanta, completed the course in 41 minutes and 12 seconds. She won the women's division title and placed second overall. 来自佛罗里达州大派恩礁的 15 岁的瓦茨拉夫·布尔萨获得总排名第一。……来自亚特兰大的 28 岁的乔安娜·斯蒂芬斯以 41 分 12 秒完成赛程。她赢得女子组冠军，总排名第二。
explain.信号: 两人各自的名次陈述。答案句不靠转折词，而靠「人物+成绩」的并列陈述定位：finished first overall 和 won the women's division title 分别说明两人都拿了各自组别第一——他 们都是「这场 7 Mile Bridge Run 的获胜者」，这正是选项 B 的概括。
explain.替换: finished first overall ↔won this year's 7 Mile Bridge Run 「总排名第一」=「赢了这场比赛」
explain.排除: A) 张冠李戴 选项盗了原文真实出现的地名「Atlanta」诱你听到就选，但 Atlanta 只属于 28 岁的 Stephens；15 岁的 Bursa 来自 Florida。说两人「都是来自亚特兰大的青少年」既错配了 城市，又把 28 岁的人也算成 teenager，双重不符。 借用原文：Joanna Stephens, 28, of Atlanta C) 与原文相反 原文用时是 41 minutes and 1 second 与 41 minutes and 12 seconds，都是 41 分多， 明明大于 40 分钟；选项偏说「less than 40 minutes（少于 40 分钟）」。它盗用了「分钟 数」这个耳熟数字，却把实际 41 多分钟篡改成「不到 40 分」，方向正好相反。 借用原文：41 minutes and 1 second D) 原词陷阱 「Marathon High School」原文确实出现，极易让人听到就选；但原文只说 He is a student at Marathon High School，这个「He」指 Bursa 一人。选项说两人「都是 （both）」该校学生，把只属于 Bursa 的身份硬扣给了 Stephens。 借用原文：He is a student at Marathon High School

optionsZh: 他们是来自亚特兰大的青少年。
他们赢得了今年的7英里桥梁跑比赛。
他们在不到40分钟内完成了比赛。
他们都是Marathon高中的学生。
options: They are young teenagers from Atlanta.
They won this year's 7 Mile Bridge Run.
They completed the race in less than 40 minutes.
They are both students at Marathon High School.

questions.stem: What do we learn about the April contest?
questions.stemZh: 关于四月的比赛我们了解到什么?
questions.answerText: It is one of the most popular running events in the southeastern U.S.

explain.定位: The April contest is one of the most popular running events in the southeastern United States. 这场四月的赛事是美国东南部最受欢迎的跑步活动之一。
explain.信号: 最高级定性句即结论。答案句靠最高级信号锁定：one of the most popular running events in the southeastern United States 是对赛事地位的定性总结，几乎与选项 D 逐字 对应。听到「one of the most…」这种最高级评价句，要立刻意识到它往往就是某道题的 答案落点。
explain.替换: one of the most popular running events in the southeastern United States ↔ It is one of the most popular running events in the southeastern U.S. 几乎逐字对应，仅缩写化
explain.排除: A) 偷换概念 原文说 drew competitors from 41 US states——来自 41 个「州」，另有 Canada, the UK and Switzerland 等少数几国选手。选项盗用「40 多」这个数量级，却把「states （州）」偷换成「countries（国家）」，参赛国其实只有零星几个，远到不了 40 个。 借用原文：The race drew competitors from 41 US states. B) 未提及 原文涉及「online」的只有 online registration opened in January——指线上「报名」， 全文从未说有人「在线观看直播（watched live online）」。选项把「线上报名」悄悄换成 「全球粉丝线上观看」，是没有原文支撑的编造。 借用原文：after online registration opened in January C) 原词陷阱 原文是 closed the span between the Middle and Lower Keys to traffic for 3 hours ——封的是中、下礁岛之间的那段「桥/路」三小时；选项把「3 hours」和「closed」原样 搬来，却说封的是「the city of Big Pine Key（整座大派恩礁城）」，封闭对象被偷换了。 借用原文：The run closed the span between the Middle and Lower Keys to traffic for 3 hours

optionsZh: 它吸引了来自40多个国家的参赛者。
它被全世界的粉丝在线观看直播。
它使Big Pine Key市封闭交通三小时。
它是美国东南部最受欢迎的跑步赛事之一。
options: It drew competitors from more than 40 countries.
It is watched live online by fans all over the world.
It closed the city of Big Pine Key to traffic for three hours.
It is one of the most popular running events in the southeastern U.S. Questions 3 and 4 are based on the news report you have just heard.

questions.stem: What do we learn from the news report about Tim Peake?
questions.stemZh: 从新闻报道中我们了解到关于Tim Peake的什么信息？
questions.answerText: He used to be a helicopter pilot.

explain.定位: The former British Army Air Corps helicopter pilot was selected as a European Space Agency astronaut in 2009. 这位前英国陆军航空兵的直升机飞行员于 2009 年被选为欧洲航天局的宇航员。
explain.信号: former 点出'过去身份'。答案句开头的 The former British Army Air Corps helicopter pilot 里 former(过去的)就是信号词：它直接交代了 Tim Peake 过去的身份是直升机飞行 员，正对 Q3 '关于他我们了解到什么'。
explain.替换: The former British Army Air Corps helicopter pilot ↔He used to be a helicopter pilot. former 名词 = used to be 动词
explain.排除: A) 原词陷阱 录音确实念到 ambassador，但说的是他将去 take up a full-time position as ambassador——这是接下来要担任的新职，不是过去就当过；A 把'即将担任'说成 was once(曾经是),时间方向错了。 借用原文：He's going to take up a full-time position as ambassador for science and space B) 偷换概念 录音说的是他从'欧洲宇航员'岗位上 stepping down permanently from his role as a European astronaut(永久卸任宇航员角色)，并非从军队退役；B 把'卸任宇航员'偷换成'即 将从军队退役'，army 一词也只在他过去身份里出现，并未说他要退役。 借用原文：Tim Peake is stepping down permanently from his role as a European astronaut C) 张冠李戴 录音里 2015 对应的是 He flew to the space station for a 6-month tour in 2015.(2015 年飞往空间站)，而'被选为宇航员'是 selected as a European Space Agency astronaut in 2009(2009 年)；C 把 astronaut 与 2015 错配，年份张冠李戴。 借用原文：He flew to the space station for a 6-month tour in 2015.

optionsZh: 他曾经是一名全职大使。
他即将从军队退役。
他在2015年成为一名宇航员。
他曾经是一名直升机飞行员。
options: He was once a full-time ambassador.
He was soon to retire from the army.
He used to be a helicopter pilot.

questions.stem: What does Tim Peake say about his work with the European Space Agency?
questions.stemZh: Tim Peake如何评价他在欧洲航天局的工作？
questions.answerText: It has been unbelievably exciting and rewarding.

explain.定位: It has been incredibly exciting and rewarding. 这(段经历)一直非常激动人心、收获满满。
explain.信号: 引语里的评价形容词即落点。态度题的落点在当事人自述的评价词。录音引语里 It has been incredibly exciting and rewarding. 用 exciting、rewarding 两个褒义形容词直接给 出他对工作的评价，正是答案句。
explain.替换: incredibly exciting and rewarding ↔unbelievably exciting and rewarding incredibly = unbelievably 同义替换
explain.排除: B) 与原文相反 extraordinarily tough and demanding 是负面评价，但他原话是 incredibly exciting and rewarding(激动、有收获)这类褒义；B 把好评偷换成差评，极性正相反。录音里确有 extraordinary 一词(说 the most extraordinary experience)，B 借这个原词制造迷惑。 借用原文：Being an astronaut has been the most extraordinary experience. C) 原词陷阱 录音确有 an ambassador for human flights to space 这串词，但那是讲他将担任的新角 色，不是评价这份工作'对航天贡献巨大'；题干问他怎么评价工作，C 答成'贡献'，是听到原 词就选的答非所问。 借用原文：By assuming the role of an ambassador for human flights to space D) 张冠李戴 录音里 privilege 出现在 I've had the privilege of working with an exceptional team(有 幸与优秀团队共事)，讲的是与团队合作的荣幸，不是'作为 ambassador 的特殊荣誉'；D 把 privilege 和 ambassador 硬凑到一起，张冠李戴。 借用原文：I've had the privilege of working with an exceptional team of individuals 1 An Asda store in Wales is now home to five cats after they wandered in and made themselves comfortable. The supermarket is known for its loyal customers, but now has a different kind of visitor that has appeared over the last year. Regular shoppers at the supermarket are familiar with the sight of several cats settling down in the shop aisles. The unusual situation started about 12 months ago, when one cat routinely started visiting the store. Local newspapers reported that puzzled customers posted on Facebook groups to try to find out if the cat was lost. But its owner assured the concerned customers it was very much loved and fed at home. It just enjoyed visiting the shop. Staff did their best to discourage the pet from hanging around. But instead of leaving and never coming back, it invited its friends round. There are now at least five different cats who come almost on a daily basis. They visit the store so much that staff have been forced to put up signs, asking their customers not to feed them. 威尔士的一家Asda超市现在成了五只猫的家，它们闲逛进来后就舒适地住了下来。这家超市以忠实顾客 而闻名,但现在有了一种不同类型的访客,它们在过去一年里出现了。超市的常客们对几只猫在店内过道安 顿下来的景象已经很熟悉。这种不寻常的情况始于大约12个月前,当时一只猫开始例行光顾这家店。当地 报纸报道称,困惑的顾客在Facebook群组上发帖,试图查明这只猫是否走失。但它的主人向关心的顾客们保 证,这只猫在家里非常受宠爱且喂养充足,它只是喜欢光顾这家店。工作人员尽力阻止这只宠物在附近逗留, 但它非但没有离开且再也不回来,反而邀请了它的朋友们过来。现在至少有五只不同的猫几乎每天都来。它 们光顾超市的次数如此之多,以至于工作人员不得不张贴告示,要求顾客不要喂它们。

optionsZh: 令人难以置信地激动人心且有意义。
异常艰苦且要求严格。
对人类太空飞行做出了巨大贡献。
作为大使赋予了他特殊的荣誉。
options: It has been unbelievably exciting and rewarding.
It has been extraordinarily tough and demanding.
It has contributed a great deal to human flights to space.
It has given him exceptional privilege as an ambassador.

questions.stem: What do we learn about the five cats seen in the Asda store? Questions 5 to 7 are based on the news report you have just heard.
questions.stemZh: 关于在Asda商店看到的五只猫，我们了解到什么？
questions.answerText: They are regular visitors to the store.

explain.定位: Regular shoppers at the supermarket are familiar with the sight of several cats settling down in the shop aisles. There are now at least five different cats who come almost on a daily basis. 超市的常客们对几只猫在店内过道里安顿下来的景象已经习以为常。如今至少有五只不同的 猫几乎天天都来。
explain.信号: 客观陈述句直接交代猫的常态。新闻里没有转折，答案就藏在平铺直叙交代事实的句子里： several cats settling down in the shop aisles 配上 five different cats who come almost on a daily basis，直接说明这几只猫是几乎天天来店里的常客。听到 "come almost on a daily basis"（几乎每天都来）就该锁定这是答案句。
explain.替换: five different cats who come almost on a daily basis ↔regular visitors to the store "几乎每天来"="常客"
explain.排除: A) 原词陷阱 loyalty to their owners 抓住了录音里的 loyal 这个原词，可录音 The supermarket is known for its loyal customers 说的是超市以"忠实顾客"闻名，忠诚指的是人、不是猫，更 没说猫忠于主人。听到 loyal 就选 A，正中原词陷阱。 借用原文：The supermarket is known for its loyal customers B) 未提及 brought in by the store's customers 听起来合理，但录音明说猫是 wandered in and made themselves comfortable（自己晃进来安顿下来），第一只是 one cat routinely started visiting the store，没有任何"顾客带进来"的内容，属凭常识硬安、原文未提及。 借用原文：wandered in and made themselves comfortable D) 原词陷阱 pets kept by the store staff 借了录音里的 staff 和 pet 两个原词，可录音里 Staff did their best to discourage the pet from hanging around 说的是店员想方设法"赶"猫、不 让它逗留，恰恰说明猫不归店员所有。听到 staff、pet 就选 D，又是原词陷阱。 借用原文：Staff did their best to discourage the pet from hanging around

optionsZh: 它们以对主人的忠诚而闻名。
它们是由商店的顾客带进来的。
它们是商店的常客。
它们是商店员工饲养的宠物。
options: They are known for their loyalty to their owners.
They are brought in by the store's customers.
They are regular visitors to the store.
They are pets kept by the store staff.

questions.stem: What did some customers think when they saw the first cat routinely appear in the store?
questions.stemZh: 当一些顾客看到第一只猫经常出现在商店时，他们是怎么想的？

explain.定位: Local newspapers reported that puzzled customers posted on Facebook groups to try to find out if the cat was lost. 当地报纸报道说，困惑的顾客在脸书群组里发帖，想弄清楚这只猫是不是走丢了。
explain.信号: 顾客行为句直接道出"以为它丢了"。描述顾客当时反应的句子就是答案句：puzzled customers posted on Facebook groups to try to find out if the cat was lost——困惑 的顾客发帖打听"猫是不是走丢了"。其中 if the cat was lost 直接点出顾客脑中的念头。听 到 puzzled（困惑的）和 lost 就该锁定。
explain.替换: to try to find out if the cat was lost ↔It might have got lost. "想弄清是否走丢"="它可能走丢了"
explain.排除: A) 答非所问 nuisance to the loyal shoppers 借了 loyal/shoppers 的影子，但录音里顾客看到第一只 猫时是 puzzled（困惑），去打听它是否走丢，并没有觉得它"惹人嫌"。猫多到要贴告示是 后文的事，且也没说它惹忠实顾客嫌，时间和内容都对不上。 借用原文：puzzled customers B) 偷换概念 abandoned by its owner 与正解贴得最近，都是"它出事了"，但录音里顾客打听的是 if the cat was lost（是否走丢），是"丢"不是"主人不要了"。况且下文 its owner assured the concerned customers it was very much loved 说主人很爱它，根本没被遗弃。错在 偷换了"走丢"与"被弃"这两个相近却不同的概念。 借用原文：if the cat was lost C) 原词陷阱 It might be 12 months old. 抓住录音真念过的 12 个月，但录音 The unusual situation started about 12 months ago 说的是"这桩怪事大约始于 12 个月前"，12 个月是"猫开始 来店多久"，根本不是"猫 12 个月大"。听到 12 months 就选 C，是典型的数字原词陷阱。 借用原文：The unusual situation started about 12 months ago

optionsZh: 它可能会给忠实顾客带来麻烦。
它可能被主人遗弃了。
它可能有12个月大。
它可能迷路了。
options: It might be a nuisance to the loyal shoppers.
It might have been abandoned by its owner.

questions.stem: What are customers asked not to do?
questions.stemZh: 顾客被要求不要做什么？

explain.定位: They visit the store so much that staff have been forced to put up signs, asking their customers not to feed them. 这些猫太常来店里，以至于店员不得不张贴告示，要求顾客不要喂它们。
explain.信号: 请求句 asking…not to 直接给出禁止内容。答案句末尾的请求结构就是定位信号：asking their customers not to feed them（要求顾客不要喂它们）。听到 not to + 动词，紧跟 的 feed 就是被禁止的那件事。这是"听要求句、抓 not to 后面的动作"的标准落点。
explain.替换: not to feed them ↔Feed the cats. "不要喂它们"对应被禁动作"喂猫"
explain.排除: B) 原词陷阱 Remove any store signs. 抓住录音真念过的 signs，可录音 staff have been forced to put up signs 说的是店员"贴"告示，从没要求顾客"撤"告示。听到 signs 就选 B，正中原词 陷阱，且把"贴"反成了"撤"。 借用原文：staff have been forced to put up signs C) 张冠李戴 Sit in the shop aisles. 借了录音原词 aisles，可录音 several cats settling down in the shop aisles 说的是猫在过道里安顿，不是顾客坐过道，更没人要求顾客别坐。听到 aisles 就选 C，是原词陷阱加张冠李戴。 借用原文：several cats settling down in the shop aisles D) 未提及 Bring in pets with them. 蹭了录音里的 pet 一词，但录音里店员唯一对顾客提的要求是 not to feed them（别喂猫），从没说过"别带宠物进店"。带宠物进店是凭常识联想出来 的，原文并未提及。 借用原文：asking their customers not to feed them Section B 1 W: I've been thinking about moving off campus next semester. W: 我一直在考虑下学期搬出学校住。 Questions 8 to 11 are based on the conversation you have just heard. 2 M: Hmm… I don't know if that's a good idea as your mother and I would worry about you living all by yourself in an apartment so far from home. And then there's the expense, too. I'm not sure we can afford it. M: 嗯……我不知道这是不是个好主意，你妈妈和我会担心你一个人住在离家这么远的公寓里。还有费用问 题。我不确定我们负担得起。 3 W: Well, I wouldn't be alone, actually. Three of my friends from the dormitory would share the place with me. And with four of us, it wouldn't cost any more than living in the dorm. W: 其实我不会一个人住。宿舍里的三个朋友会和我一起合租。我们四个人的话，花费不会比住宿舍多。 4 M: Are you sure about that? Rents in big cities are high, and then there's the cost of electricity and gas. Have you factored those in? M: 你确定吗?大城市的房租很高，还有电费和燃气费。你把这些都算进去了吗? 5 W: We've budgeted for those, and for Internet and transportation. And if we move far enough from the city center, the rent is low enough for us to afford all of it. W: 我们已经把这些都做了预算，还有网费和交通费。如果我们搬得离市中心远一点，房租就足够低,我们 能负担得起所有这些。 6 M: What's about the commute to and from campus? It sounds like you'll be wasting several hours every day on the road instead of studying. M: 那往返学校怎么办?听起来你每天要在路上浪费好几个小时，而不是用来学习。 7 W: It's about an hour to campus, but there's no reason I can't study on the bus. After all, I did that during high school and my commute was even longer then. W: 到学校大约一小时，但我完全可以在公交车上学习。毕竟我高中时就是这么做的，那时候通勤时间还 更长呢。 8 M: That's true. But I'm not sure why you want to leave campus and go through all that trouble when the cost is the same. M: 这倒是真的。但我不明白既然费用一样，你为什么要离开学校，费这么大劲儿。 9 W: For a lot of reasons. We'd have a kitchen, so we could cook ourselves. And we'd each have our own bedroom, where we could study instead of going to the library. We just have more space and privacy. W: 原因有很多。我们会有厨房，可以自己做饭。而且我们每个人都有自己的卧室，可以在那里学习，不 用去图书馆。我们就是有更多空间和隐私。 10 M: I'm not convinced that the benefits are greater than the disadvantages, but I'll discuss this with your mother. M: 我还不确定好处是否大于坏处，但我会和你妈妈商量一下。

questions.stem: What has the woman been thinking of doing next semester?
questions.stemZh: 这位女士一直在考虑下学期做什么?

explain.定位: W: I've been thinking about moving off campus next semester. 女：我一直在考虑下学期搬到校外去住。
explain.信号: 开场首句直陈打算。信号是女方对话开场第一句的直接陈述 I've been thinking about moving off campus next semester.，与题干 thinking of doing 完全对应——这就是承 载答案的那句。
explain.替换: moving off campus ↔Living off campus moving=living 同指搬离校园住
explain.排除: A) 张冠李戴 Sharing her room with friends. 借了后文女方说的 Three of my friends from the dormitory would share the place with me，但那是『四人合租整套房子』，不是『与朋 友合住一个房间』，且非她最初的打算，是把后文细节错安到本题。 借用原文：Three of my friends from the dormitory would share the place with me B) 原词陷阱 Cutting down her living expenses. 盗用了原文反复出现的 the expense 一词，但女方的 打算是搬出校外，省钱只是搬出后讨论的一个方面，不是她『在考虑做的事』本身，听到 expense 就选会落坑。 借用原文：And then there's the expense, too. D) 与原文相反 Moving to the city center. 与原文正相反：女方说的是 if we move far enough from the city center（搬到离市中心足够远的地方），选项却说搬向市中心，极性反了。 借用原文：if we move far enough from the city center

optionsZh: 与朋友合住一个房间。
削减她的生活开支。
住在校外。
搬到市中心。

questions.stem: What does the man suggest the woman take into consideration?
questions.stemZh: 这位男士建议这位女士考虑什么?

explain.定位: M: Are you sure about that? Rents in big cities are high, and then there's the cost of electricity and gas. Have you factored those in? 男：你确定吗？大城市的房租很高，还有电费和燃气费。这些你都算进去了吗？
explain.信号: 连列费用项+反问提醒。信号是男方一口气列出 Rents in big cities are high, and then there's the cost of electricity and gas 并反问 Have you factored those in?——他反复 强调、要女方算进去的正是各项费用，这就是答案句。
explain.替换: Rents in big cities are high, and then there's the cost of electricity and gas ↔ Various costs involved 罗列各项费用=概括为各种费用
explain.排除: A) 张冠李戴 The facilities available. 看似贴居住话题，但原文男方提醒的是费用，厨房、卧室等设施是 后文女方自己列搬出去的好处 We'd have a kitchen，并非男方让她『考虑』的事，张冠李 戴。 借用原文：We'd have a kitchen, so we could cook ourselves. C) 偷换概念 Changes in living conditions. 借用了贯穿全程的 living 一词，但男方让考虑的是『费用』 这一具体方面，不是笼统的『生活条件变化』，把具体范畴偷换成宽泛说法。 借用原文：if we move far enough from the city center, the rent is low enough D) 原词陷阱 The distance to her home. 盗用了男方开头 so far from home 里的 home 一词，但那是 男方表达担忧的话，并非他要女方『纳入考虑』的方面，且真正反复提醒的是费用，听到 home 就选会落坑。 借用原文：living all by yourself in an apartment so far from home

optionsZh: 可用的设施。
涉及的各种费用。
生活条件的变化。
到她家的距离。

questions.stem: What does the woman say she did during high school?
questions.stemZh: 这位女士说她在高中期间做了什么?

explain.定位: W: It's about an hour to campus, but there's no reason I can't study on the bus. After all, I did that during high school and my commute was even longer then. 女：到学校大约一小时，但我没理由不能在公交车上学习啊。毕竟我高中时就是这么做的， 那时候我通勤路上的时间还更长呢。
explain.信号: 时间词 during high school 处的回指。信号是题干时间词在原文的复现 I did that during high school，而 that 回指紧挨着的 study on the bus——这句就是答案句。
explain.替换: I did that during high school ↔Studied on the bus that 回指 study on the bus
explain.排除: A) 张冠李戴 Went through much trouble. 借了男方的话 go through all that trouble，但那是男方对 『搬出去折腾』的评价，不是女方说她高中做过的事，把男方的话安到女方头上。 借用原文：go through all that trouble B) 原词陷阱 Commuted to save money. 把原文出现的 commute（my commute was even longer） 和前文省钱话题拼在一起，但女方说高中时做的是在车上学习，并非『为省钱而通勤』，且 省钱是合租话题、不是高中经历。 借用原文：my commute was even longer then D) 与原文相反 Lived on campus. 借用了贯穿全程的 campus、live 等词，但女方高中时是通勤 （commute 路上更长），恰恰说明她当时没住校，选项与原意相反。 借用原文：my commute was even longer then

optionsZh: 经历了很多麻烦。
通勤以省钱。
在公交车上学习。
住在校园里。

questions.stem: What does the man say he'll do at the end of the conversation?
questions.stemZh: 这位男士说他在对话结束时会做什么?
questions.answerText: Discuss the matter with the woman's mother.

explain.定位: M: I'm not convinced that the benefits are greater than the disadvantages, but I'll discuss this with your mother. 男：我还不太相信好处大过坏处，不过我会和你妈妈商量一下这件事。
explain.信号: 转折 but 后的 I'll 表态。信号是结尾男方转折词 but 之后的 I'll discuss this with your mother——but 之后才是他真正要做的事，这就是答案句。
explain.替换: I'll discuss this with your mother ↔Discuss the matter with the woman's mother this=the matter、your mother=woman's mother
explain.排除: B) 未提及 Make a decision within a few days. 里 within a few days 录音从头到尾没出现，是凭 『商量后该尽快决定』的常识脑补出来的时限，原文未提。 C) 偷换概念 Try his best to persuade his wife. 把男方要找 mother（即他妻子）这层关系拿来，却说 成『努力说服妻子』，可原文是 discuss this with your mother——是平等商量，不是单 方说服，把『商量』偷换成『说服』。 借用原文：I'll discuss this with your mother D) 原词陷阱 Weigh the benefits against the disadvantages. 盗用了同句 the benefits are greater than the disadvantages 的原词，但那是男方表达『还没被说服』的态度（but 之前），不 是他说接下来要做的事；他要做的是商量，听到 benefits/disadvantages 就选会落坑。 借用原文：I'm not convinced that the benefits are greater than the disadvantages 1 W: Good morning. I'm looking for a present for my nephew, Lawrence. W: 早上好。我想给我侄子Lawrence买个礼物。 2 M: Hi. Do you have anything in mind? M: 您好。您有什么想法吗? 3 W: I'm not sure. No. Do you know what boys aged around ten typically like? W: 我不太确定。没有。您知道十岁左右的男孩一般喜欢什么吗? 4 M: For that age group, our biggest seller this year has been this action figure. It's called Bobo Man, and it's incredibly popular. M: 对于这个年龄段,我们今年卖得最好的是这个动作人偶。它叫Bobo Man,非常受欢迎。 5 W: Does it do anything? W: 它能做什么吗? 6 M: Not by itself. It has no batteries, if that's what you mean. There's a Bobo Man cartoon popular amongst young children, you see. And this toy is the lead character from the show. M: 它本身不会动。如果您是问它有没有电池的话,是没有的。您看,有一部叫Bobo Man的动画片在小孩子 中很受欢迎。这个玩具就是剧中的主角。 7 W: Oh, I understand now. I've never heard of it, but I do know little Lawrence loves cartoons. Do you have any other popular toys? Perhaps something educational. W: 哦,我现在明白了。我从来没听说过,但我知道小Lawrence很喜欢看动画片。您还有其他受欢迎的玩具 吗?也许是有教育意义的。 Questions 12 to 15 are based on the conversation you have just heard. 8 M: Yes, of course. Right over here, we have dozens of puzzles for children of all ages. They are fun, great for exercising the mind and can be played either alone or in groups. M: 有的,当然有。就在这边,我们有几十种适合各个年龄段儿童的拼图。它们很有趣,非常适合锻炼思维,而 且可以单独玩也可以多人一起玩。 9 W: I like this sort of idea. Lawrence has a sister who is slightly older, so maybe a game that they can play together would be good. W: 我喜欢这种想法。Lawrence有个姐姐年龄稍大一点,所以也许买个他们可以一起玩的游戏会不错。 10 M: What do you think of Battleships, then? It's a total classic. It has been around since the 1930s. M: 那您觉得海战棋怎么样?这是个绝对的经典游戏。从1930年代就有了。 11 W: Oh, yeah. We had one of those when growing up. W: 哦,对。我们小时候就有一套。 12 M: Of course you did. Everyone did. And kids enjoy it just as much today as you and I did when we were young. Some games just never get old. M: 当然了。每个人都有。而且孩子们现在玩它和我们小时候一样喜欢。有些游戏就是永远不会过时。 13 W: I suppose you are right. I have fond memories playing Battleships when it was raining outside and we had to stay indoors. That's decided then. How much? W: 我想您说得对。我对在外面下雨不得不待在室内时玩海战棋有着美好的回忆。那就这么定了。多少钱? 14 M: 19 pounds and 90 pence, please. M: 19英镑90便士。 15 W: There you are. Have a nice day. W: 给您。祝您愉快。 16 M: Thank you. You too. M: 谢谢。您也是。

optionsZh: 与这位女士的母亲讨论这件事。
在几天内做出决定。
尽力说服他的妻子。
权衡利弊。
options: Discuss the matter with the woman's mother.
Make a decision within a few days.
Try his best to persuade his wife.
Weigh the benefits against the disadvantages.

questions.stem: What is the woman doing?
questions.stemZh: 这位女士在做什么?
questions.answerText: Choosing a present for her nephew.

explain.定位: W: Good morning. I'm looking for a present for my nephew, Lawrence. 女：早上好。我在给我侄子劳伦斯找一份礼物。
explain.信号: 开场自报来意。女士一开口就用 I'm looking for a present for my nephew 交代了来店目 的，这种"开场自述要做什么"的句子就是 What doing 题的答案句。
explain.替换: looking for a present for my nephew ↔Choosing a present for her nephew looking for=Choosing 同义改写
explain.排除: A) 张冠李戴 全程是女士向店员咨询、店员介绍商品，没有任何采访行为；Interviewing the man. 把"咨 询"误当"采访"，且弄反了谁主导对话。 B) 原词陷阱 录音确实念到了 Lawrence，但 Lawrence 是要送礼的侄子，女士并不是在"找劳伦斯本 人"；Looking for Lawrence. 偷了这个人名来骗"听到就选"。 借用原文：I'm looking for a present for my nephew, Lawrence D) 与原文相反 是店员（男士）在帮女士选礼物，不是女士帮男士购物；Helping the man with his shopping. 把帮忙的方向反了过来。

optionsZh: 正在面试这位男士。
正在寻找Lawrence。
正在为她的侄子挑选礼物。
正在帮这位男士购物。
options: Choosing a present for her nephew.
Helping the man with his shopping.

questions.stem: How does the man describe Bobo Man, the action figure?
questions.stemZh: 这位男士如何描述Bobo Man这个动作人偶?

explain.定位: M: For that age group, our biggest seller this year has been this action figure. It's called Bobo Man, and it's incredibly popular. 男：对这个年龄段，我们今年卖得最好的就是这个人偶。它叫 Bobo Man，非常受欢迎。
explain.信号: 店员正面推介的形容。男士介绍这件玩具时直接说 it's incredibly popular，这句正面评价 就是"他如何描述它"的答案句。
explain.替换: it's incredibly popular ↔Incredibly popular. 原句直取，几乎零改写
explain.排除: A) 原词陷阱 educational 确实在录音出现，但那是女士后来问 something educational、指向拼图，并 非男士对 Bobo Man 的描述；Quite educational. 把后文别处的词搬来安到 Bobo Man 头 上。 借用原文：Perhaps something educational C) 与原文相反 batteries 在录音里出现，但男士明确说 It has no batteries——它"没有"电池；Driven by batteries. 取了原词却反了意思。 借用原文：It has no batteries D) 未提及 录音从未把 Bobo Man 说成幼稚；男士只说它受欢迎、是动画主角。Obviously childish. 属于凭印象编的负面评价，原文无据。

optionsZh: 相当有教育意义。
非常受欢迎。
由电池驱动。
明显很幼稚。

questions.stem: What kind of game does the woman think would be good for Lawrence?
questions.stemZh: 这位女士认为什么样的游戏适合Lawrence?
questions.answerText: One he can play together with his sister.

explain.定位: W: I like this sort of idea. Lawrence has a sister who is slightly older, so maybe a game that they can play together would be good. 女：我喜欢这个主意。劳伦斯有个稍大一点的姐姐，所以也许一款他们能一起玩的游戏会 不错。
explain.信号: 女士本人 so...would be good 的结论。女士先说有姐姐，再用 so maybe a game that they can play together would be good 给出她看重的条件——"两人一起玩"，这正是 think...good 的答案句。
explain.替换: a game that they can play together ↔One he can play together with his sister they=他和姐姐，指代还原
explain.排除: A) 张冠李戴 exercising the mind 出现在录音，但那是男士介绍拼图时说 great for exercising the mind，不是女士看重的理由；题干问的是女士的想法，故 One he loves for helping exercise his mind. 张冠李戴。 借用原文：great for exercising the mind C) 未提及 女士没有说看重"有趣又有挑战"；challenging 一词录音根本没出现。One he finds interesting and challenging. 是凭印象编的卖点。 D) 张冠李戴 play either alone or in groups 确在录音，但那是男士介绍拼图的卖点 can be played either alone or in groups，不是女士对劳伦斯看重的点；女士看重的是"和姐姐一起"。 One he can play either alone or in a group. 把店员的话当成女士的判断。 借用原文：can be played either alone or in groups

optionsZh: 一个他喜欢的有助于锻炼思维的游戏。
一个他可以和妹妹一起玩的游戏。
一个他觉得有趣且有挑战性的游戏。
一个他可以单独玩或集体玩的游戏。
options: One he loves for helping exercise his mind.
One he can play together with his sister.
One he finds interesting and challenging.
One he can play either alone or in a group.

questions.stem: What do we learn from the conversation about the game Battleships?
questions.stemZh: 从对话中我们了解到关于Battleships这个游戏的什么信息?
questions.answerText: It has been enjoyed by kids for decades.

explain.定位: M: Of course you did. Everyone did. And kids enjoy it just as much today as you and I did when we were young. Some games just never get old. 男：你当然玩过。人人都玩过。而且如今的孩子玩它玩得和当年的你我一样开心。有些游戏 就是永不过时。
explain.信号: 多年仍受孩子喜爱的信息点。男士说 kids enjoy it just as much today as you and I did when we were young，加上前文 It has been around since the 1930s，合起来支持"几 十年来一直被孩子喜爱"。
explain.替换: It has been around since the 1930s ↔It has been enjoyed by kids for decades since the 1930s=for decades kids enjoy it just as much today as you and I did when we were young ↔ It has been enjoyed by kids for decades 孩子持续喜爱=enjoyed by kids
explain.排除: B) 过度推断 录音只说这游戏经典、不过时，从没说它"让人想起战争"。It always reminds people of times of war. 是看 Battleships（战舰）这名字凭空联想，原文无据，且 always 太绝对。 C) 原词陷阱 女士提到 we had to stay indoors（下雨只能待室内玩），录音只说室内，从没说室外也 玩；It has been played both indoors and outdoors. 偷了 indoors 一词，却擅自加上 outdoors。 借用原文：we had to stay indoors D) 过度推断 男士只说它是 a total classic、自 1930 年代就有，并没说它"是最古老的游戏之一"；It distinguishes itself as one of the oldest games. 把"经典"拔高成"最古老之一"，程度过 头。 借用原文：It's a total classic Section C 1 We assume that if we offer our customers more choices, then they'll be more likely to buy our products. But here's the paradox of choice: if a person is presented with too many choices, they are actually less likely to buy. In 2012, psychologists published a study about jams. On a regular day at a local food market, people would find a display table with 24 different kinds of jams. Then on another day, at that same food market, people were given only 6 different types of jam choices. Guess which display table led to more sales? 我们假设如果给顾客提供更多选择，他们就更有可能购买我们的产品。但这里存在选择悖论：如果一个人 面对太多选择，他们实际上购买的可能性反而更低。2012年，心理学家发表了一项关于果酱的研究。在 当地食品市场的普通日子里，人们会看到一张陈列桌上摆放着24种不同的果酱。然后在另一天，在同一个 食品市场，人们只被提供6种不同类型的果酱选择。猜猜哪张陈列桌带来了更多销售？ 2 The study found that while the bigger display table created more interest, people were almost 10 times less likely to purchase a jar of jam than in the case of the smaller display. Customer satisfaction takes a hit as well. In the study, the bigger display of jams leads to lower customer satisfaction than the smaller display. In an extensive study published in 2015, researchers analyzed a total of 99 choice studies and specifically looked at those cases in which reducing choices helped to boost sales. They found four rules that motivate consumers to buy: when people want to make a quick and easy choice, when the product Questions 16 to 18 are based on the passage you have just heard. is complex, when it's difficult to compare alternatives, and when consumers don't have clear preferences. So as you can see, when it comes to choices, less is more. 研究发现，虽然更大的陈列桌引起了更多兴趣，但与较小陈列桌的情况相比，人们购买一罐果酱的可能性 几乎低了10倍。顾客满意度也受到了影响。在该研究中，更大的果酱陈列带来的顾客满意度低于较小的陈 列。在2015年发表的一项广泛研究中，研究人员分析了总共99项选择研究，并专门关注那些减少选择有 助于促进销售的案例。他们发现了四条激励消费者购买的规则：当人们想要做出快速简单的选择时，当产 品复杂时，当难以比较替代品时，以及当消费者没有明确偏好时。所以你可以看到，在选择方面，少即 是多。

optionsZh: 几十年来一直深受孩子们喜爱。
总是让人想起战争时期。
既可以在室内玩也可以在室外玩。
作为最古老的游戏之一而与众不同。
options: It has been enjoyed by kids for decades.
It always reminds people of times of war.
It has been played both indoors and outdoors.
It distinguishes itself as one of the oldest games.

questions.stem: What do we learn from the passage about the paradox of choice?
questions.stemZh: 从文章中我们对选择悖论了解到什么?
questions.answerText: Too many choices decrease one's desire to buy.

explain.定位: But here's the paradox of choice: if a person is presented with too many choices, they are actually less likely to buy. 但这就是“选择悖论”：如果一个人面对太多选择，他实际上反而更不可能购买。
explain.信号: 转折 But 加冒号点题，后半才是真意。前一句 We assume that if we offer our customers more choices, then they'll be more likely to buy 是“我们以为”的错误假设， 紧跟 But here's the paradox of choice 用转折加冒号正式抛出概念，转折后的内容才是答 案句。
explain.替换: too many choices ↔Too many choices 原词同形保留 less likely to buy ↔decrease one's desire to buy “更不可能买”=“降低购买欲”，同义改写
explain.排除: A) 原词陷阱 A 说陈列多样“增加兴趣”，借的是后文 created more interest里的 interest，但本题问的是 paradox of choice 的核心结论，原文用 But 推翻的正是“选项多就更想买”这种正向假设， A 站在被推翻的一边。 借用原文：created more interest C) 与原文相反 C 说“更少选择导致更低满意度”，盗用了原文 customer satisfaction 一词，但原文 the bigger display of jams leads to lower customer satisfaction than the smaller display 说的是“更多”选择才满意度更低，C 把多少接反了，属与原文相反。 借用原文：lower customer satisfaction D) 未提及 D 说顾客“get confused”（困惑），听上去像“选择多”的合理后果，但原文从头到尾只说更 不可能买、满意度更低，从未提到“困惑”，属凭常识脑补的未提及项。

optionsZh: 多种产品的陈列会增加消费者的兴趣。
过多的选择会降低购买欲望。
较少的选择会导致较低的顾客满意度。
给予顾客更多选择更有可能使其感到困惑。
options: A display of a variety of products increases consumers' interest.
Too many choices decrease one's desire to buy.
Fewer choices lead to lower customer satisfaction.
Customers given more choices are more likely to get confused.

questions.stem: What did the psychologists want to find out in their 2012 study about jams?
questions.stemZh: 心理学家在2012年关于果酱的研究中想要弄清楚什么?
questions.answerText: What kind of display results in more sales.

explain.定位: Guess which display table led to more sales? 猜猜哪张陈列桌带来了更多销量？
explain.信号: 设问句直接点出研究要回答的问题。原文以反问 Guess which display table led to more sales?把整段研究的核心问题挑明——研究就是要看“哪种展示带来更多销量”，这个设问句 即研究目的的答案句。
explain.替换: which display table led to more sales ↔What kind of display results in more sales. “哪张桌带来更多销量”=“哪种陈列带来更多销量”
explain.排除: B) 原词陷阱 B 说研究想找“哪种展示引起更多兴趣”，借了原文 created more interest里的 interest，但 “更多兴趣”是研究顺带得出的结果，研究真正要找的是销量；B 把结果当成了研究目的。 借用原文：created more interest C) 未提及 C 说研究想找哪种展示“吸引更大客流”，crowd of customers 原文压根没出现，是凭“大展 台显眼”的常识脑补出来的，属未提及。 D) 原词陷阱 D 说研究想找哪种展示带来“更高满意度”，借了原文 customer satisfaction 一词，但满意 度同样是研究附带得出的结论，不是 2012 研究设问要找的目标；与 B 同病，混淆结果与目 的。 借用原文：lower customer satisfaction

optionsZh: 什么样的陈列方式会带来更多销售额。
什么样的陈列方式会产生更多兴趣。
什么样的陈列方式会吸引更多顾客。
什么样的陈列方式会带来更高的顾客满意度。
options: What kind of display results in more sales.
What kind of display creates more interest.
What kind of display attracts a greater crowd of customers.
What kind of display leads to greater customer satisfaction.

questions.stem: What is the finding of an extensive study published in 2015?
questions.stemZh: 2015年发表的一项广泛研究有什么发现?
questions.answerText: There are rules that motivate customers to buy.

explain.定位: They found four rules that motivate consumers to buy: when people want to make a quick and easy choice, when the product is complex, when it's difficult to compare alternatives, and when consumers don't have clear preferences. 他们发现了促使消费者购买的四条规则：当人们想做一个又快又省事的选择时、当产品很复 杂时、当难以比较各个备选项时、以及当消费者没有明确偏好时。
explain.信号: found 加冒号列举，结论句标志。原文 They found four rules that motivate consumers to buy以 found 引出、冒号后接四条列举，是这项 2015 研究的总结论句，正是“finding” 所在。
explain.替换: four rules that motivate consumers to buy ↔There are rules that motivate customers to buy. “motivate consumers to buy”=“motivate customers to buy”，近乎同形
explain.排除: A) 未提及 A 说研究发现“存在顾客什么都不买的情形”，听似贴合“选择多就不买”的主题，但 2015 研 究的发现明确是“four rules”，原文没说“buy nothing”，属把前文主题硬套到本题、未提 及。 B) 张冠李戴 B 说研究发现“提升满意度的技巧”，借了前文 customer satisfaction 一词，但满意度是前 一项果酱研究的内容，2015 研究找的是“促买规则”不是“提升满意度的技巧”，张冠李戴且偷 换概念。 借用原文：lower customer satisfaction C) 偷换概念 C 说研究发现“预测顾客偏好的方法”，盗用了原文 consumers don't have clear preferences里的 preferences，但原文说的是“消费者没有明确偏好”是促买的条件之一，绝 非“能预测偏好”，属偷换概念。 借用原文：consumers don't have clear preferences 1 The New Year has come and gone, and many may have already forgotten what they had resolved to do on January 1st. But if that resolution was to volunteer more, now is the best time to start. Volunteering can drop after the holiday season, and by February, some organizations lack the volunteers they had in surplus just a month ago. According to one survey, only 26% of Americans volunteered, despite reports that many Americans view volunteering as worthwhile. 新年已经来了又过去了,许多人可能已经忘记了他们在1月1日下定的决心。但如果那个决心是多做志愿服 务,现在正是开始的最佳时机。志愿服务在假期季节后会减少,到2月份,一些组织缺少他们在一个月前还富 余的志愿者。根据一项调查,尽管有报告显示许多美国人认为志愿服务是有价值的,但只有26%的美国人参 与了志愿服务。 2 Why such a disconnect? Most people cite time and conflicting work schedules as major barriers, but employees and employers would actually benefit if companies made employee volunteering part of the job. Researchers have found donating our time and talent to others can lower blood pressure, boost happiness and improve mental and physical health. Studies have also linked employee volunteer programs with more productive employees. With so much emphasis on employee wellness these days, company volunteer programs could be the perfect 2025 resolution. But for volunteering to benefit employees and the workplace, the entire organization needs to be involved. By allowing employees to donate their time during work hours, the workplace becomes an outlet for personal fulfillment without affecting personal time. In one survey, 89% of employees perceived companies that sponsored volunteer activities as creating a better working environment, and 75% said volunteering was critical to their well-being. 为什么会有如此大的脱节?大多数人将时间和工作时间冲突列为主要障碍,但如果公司将员工志愿服务纳入 工作的一部分,员工和雇主实际上都会受益。研究人员发现,向他人奉献我们的时间和才能可以降低血压、 提升幸福感并改善身心健康。研究还将员工志愿者项目与更高效的员工联系起来。如今如此强调员工健康, 公司志愿者项目可能是完美的2025年决心。但要让志愿服务使员工和工作场所受益,整个组织都需要参与 Questions 19 to 21 are based on the passage you have just heard. 其中。通过允许员工在工作时间内奉献他们的时间,工作场所成为个人实现的出口而不影响个人时间。在一 项调查中,89%的员工认为赞助志愿活动的公司创造了更好的工作环境,75%的人表示志愿服务对他们的福 祉至关重要。

optionsZh: 存在顾客什么都不买的情况。
存在提高顾客满意度的技巧。
存在预测顾客偏好的方法。
存在激励顾客购买的规律。
options: There are situations where customers buy nothing.
There are tricks to increase customer satisfaction.
There are ways to predict customer preferences.
There are rules that motivate customers to buy.

questions.stem: What do many Americans think of volunteering?
questions.stemZh: 许多美国人如何看待志愿服务?

explain.定位: According to one survey, only 26% of Americans volunteered, despite reports that many Americans view volunteering as worthwhile. 据一项调查，只有 26% 的美国人做过志愿服务，尽管有报道称许多美国人认为志愿服务是 值得做的。
explain.信号: 题干同词 many Americans 在 despite 让步从句里现身。答案句里 many Americans view volunteering as worthwhile 与题干 many Americans 完全对上，且 despite（尽 管）这个让步信号后面跟的正是‘大家的看法’，听到 despite + many Americans 就该锁定 这句。
explain.替换: view volunteering as worthwhile ↔Worthwhile. 原句形容词被直接抽出做选项
explain.排除: A) 未提及 很多人想当然觉得志愿‘让人有压力’，但录音对态度只给了 worthwhile 一个正面评价，从 没说 stressful，属于用常识代替文本的硬伤。 B) 与原文相反 录音明确是 worthwhile（值得、正面），Burdensome（负担重的）是负面，方向相反； 预读时已把它和 worthwhile 分到对立两组，听出正面语气即可排除。 D) 答非所问 录音后文确实讲志愿能 boost happiness、提升健康，本项把这些好处浓缩成‘提神’来诱 选，但题干问的是 many Americans think of it 的评价，答案句只给了 worthwhile，本项 答非所问。 借用原文：boost happiness

optionsZh: 有压力的。
繁重的。
值得的。
提升精力的。

questions.stem: How could companies ensure both employees and employers benefit from volunteering?
questions.stemZh: 公司如何确保员工和雇主都能从志愿服务中受益?
questions.answerText: By making it part of the job.

explain.定位: Most people cite time and conflicting work schedules as major barriers, but employees and employers would actually benefit if companies made employee volunteering part of the job. 大多数人把时间和工作排期冲突列为主要障碍，但如果公司把员工志愿服务变成工作的一部 分，员工和雇主其实都会受益。
explain.信号: 转折 but 之后才是真正答案，且 benefit 与题干呼应。but employees and employers would actually benefit if companies made employee volunteering part of the job 里，转折词 but 后面才是作者的真意，且 benefit、employees and employers 与题干 both…benefit 直接对上，听到 but 紧跟 benefit 就锁定这句。
explain.替换: made employee volunteering part of the job ↔By making it part of the job. 过去式陈述改写成 By doing，it 指代志愿
explain.排除: A) 原词陷阱 选项 By linking it with employees' salary. 借 employees 这个录音高频词显得耳熟，但录 音从未说把志愿与‘薪水’挂钩，salary 是凭常识脑补的合理做法。 借用原文：employees and employers would actually benefit B) 原词陷阱 录音确有 company volunteer programs could be the perfect 2025 resolution，本项 By taking it as the New Year resolution. 抠走 resolution 一词，但那只是把项目比作‘新 年愿望’的修辞，不是‘如何让双方受益’的办法，答非所问。 借用原文：company volunteer programs could be the perfect 2025 resolution C) 原词陷阱 录音 Most people cite time and conflicting work schedules as major barriers 把 work schedules 说成‘障碍’，本项 By improving work schedules. 把它翻成‘改善作息’当对策， 正是 but 转折前的干扰内容，与录音给的真正办法不符。 借用原文：conflicting work schedules as major barriers

optionsZh: 将其与员工的薪水挂钩。
将其作为新年决心。
改善工作日程安排。
使其成为工作的一部分。
options: By linking it with employees' salary.
By taking it as the New Year resolution.
By making it part of the job.

questions.stem: What did 75% of employees say about volunteering in a survey?
questions.stemZh: 在一项调查中,75%的员工对志愿服务有何评价?
questions.answerText: It was very important to their well-being.

explain.定位: In one survey, 89% of employees perceived companies that sponsored volunteer activities as creating a better working environment, and 75% said volunteering was critical to their well-being. 在一项调查中，89% 的员工认为赞助志愿活动的公司营造了更好的工作环境，75% 的员工 则表示志愿服务对他们的幸福感至关重要。
explain.信号: 数字 75% 直接领出答案，须与相邻 89% 切开。录音连说两个数字，75% said volunteering was critical to their well-being 才是题干要的 75%；听到 75% said 就锁定 它后半句，切勿被前面 89% 那句串台。
explain.替换: critical to their well-being ↔It was very important to their well-being. critical 同义替换为 very important
explain.排除: B) 未提及 本项 It had taken little of their spare time. 说志愿‘几乎没占业余时间’，录音 75% 的人说 的是它‘至关重要’，方向不符；录音只在前文把 time 说成‘障碍’，从没说它‘占用很少’。 C) 张冠李戴 录音确有 the workplace becomes an outlet for personal fulfillment，本项 It was an outlet for their personal fulfillment. 几乎照搬这句，但那是作者自己的论述，不是 75% 员工‘在调查中说’的内容，张冠李戴。 借用原文：the workplace becomes an outlet for personal fulfillment D) 张冠李戴 It helped improve their working environment. 取自 89% of employees perceived companies…as creating a better working environment，是相邻的 89% 那句的内容； 题干问 75%，本项把另一个数字的说法搬过来，是典型数字串台。 借用原文：89% of employees perceived companies that sponsored volunteer activities as creating a better working environment

optionsZh: 它对他们的幸福感非常重要。
它几乎没有占用他们的业余时间。
它是他们实现个人价值的途径。
它有助于改善他们的工作环境。
options: It was very important to their well-being.
It had taken little of their spare time.
It was an outlet for their personal fulfillment.
It helped improve their working environment. Questions 22 to 25 are based on the passage you have just heard.

questions.stem: What do we learn about the UK's retail sector food waste?
questions.stemZh: 关于英国零售业食品浪费,我们了解到什么?

explain.定位: The vast majority of the UK's 200,000 tonnes of retail sector's annual food waste comes from supermarkets. 英国零售业每年 20 万吨的食物浪费，绝大部分来自超市。
explain.信号: 首句正面定性 the vast majority。这是段落开篇的总起句，用 The vast majority（绝大部 分）直接给 "来源" 下定性结论——细节题的答案常落在这种正面交代主体的句子上，而不 是后面的补充。
explain.替换: The vast majority of the UK's 200,000 tonnes of retail sector's annual food waste comes from supermarkets ↔It mostly comes from supermarkets. the vast majority = mostly
explain.排除: A) 未提及 录音只说全年总量是 200,000 tonnes（20 万吨/年），选项 It amounts to 2,000 tons daily. 把数字改成 "2,000 吨/天"，数额和 "每日" 的口径都是录音没说的，属于拿一个貌似 听过的数字来骗。 借用原文：200,000 tonnes C) 原词陷阱 录音说的是 It's estimated at less than one per cent of the UK's food waste total ——"不到 1%，且是占食物浪费总量"。选项 It is estimated at 11% of the UK's total food supply. 盗用了 "estimated" 这个原词，却把 "less than one per cent" 改成 "11%"、把 "food waste total" 改成 "food supply"，数字与口径全反了。 借用原文：It's estimated at less than one per cent of the UK's food waste total D) 张冠李戴 录音说浪费主要来自超市，只是 it's a problem that impacts independent luxury food suppliers too——高端供应商只是 "也受影响" 的次要对象。选项 It has a lot to do with independent luxury food suppliers. 盗用 "independent luxury food suppliers" 这串原 词，把次要对象说成主因，张冠李戴。 借用原文：it's a problem that impacts independent luxury food suppliers too

optionsZh: 它每天达到2000吨。
它主要来自超市。
它估计占英国食品供应总量的11%。
它与独立的奢侈食品供应商有很大关系。
options: It is estimated at 11% of the UK's total food supply.
It has a lot to do with independent luxury food suppliers.

questions.stem: What does Sophie André's business do in London?
questions.stemZh: Sophie André的企业在伦敦做什么?

explain.定位: In 2016 she moved to London and began by setting up a business delivering luxury hand- made food across the city. 2016 年她搬到伦敦，先创办了一家在全城配送高端手工食品的公司。
explain.信号: creating/setting up 引出业务定义。began by setting up a business delivering luxury hand-made food 用 "setting up a business doing…" 的句式直接给这家公司的主营下定 义——这种 "创办一家做……的公司" 句就是业务题的答案句。
explain.替换: setting up a business delivering luxury hand-made food across the city ↔ It delivers luxury hand-made food. 几近原词的定性概括
explain.排除: A) 原词陷阱 录音里 "自行车" 出现在 I started delivering products by bicycle——自行车只是配送 "工 具"。选项 It rents bicycles to deliver food. 盗用 "bicycle" 原词，却把 "用自行车送货" 偷 换成 "出租自行车"，业务定位完全错了。 借用原文：I started delivering products by bicycle B) 原词陷阱 "coffee beans" 出现在第一段 sought-after coffee beans gets thrown away，说的是 "被 浪费的高端食材举例"，根本不是这家公司在卖的东西。选项 It sells sought-after coffee beans. 盗用这串原词，安到公司业务上，答非所问。 借用原文：sought-after coffee beans gets thrown away every day D) 与原文相反 录音明确说这家公司 the idea is not simply to redistribute waste food, but to provide a high-quality product——明确否定了 "只是重新分配废弃食物"。选项 It recycles waste food from the city. 盗用 "waste" 原词，恰好把录音否定掉的那层意思当成业务，与原文相 反。 借用原文：the idea is not simply to redistribute waste food, but to provide a high-quality product

optionsZh: 它出租自行车来配送食品。
它销售抢手的咖啡豆。
它配送奢侈的手工制作食品。
它回收利用来自城市的废弃食品。
options: It rents bicycles to deliver food.
It recycles waste food from the city.

questions.stem: In what way does Sophie André's business differ from many food waste projects?
questions.stemZh: Sophie André的企业在哪些方面不同于许多食品废弃物项目?
questions.answerText: It aims to provide high-quality products.

explain.定位: Unlike many food waste projects that have sprung up in recent years, the idea is not simply to redistribute waste food, but to provide a high-quality product. 与近年涌现的许多食物浪费项目不同，这个想法不只是重新分配废弃食物，而是提供高品质 产品。
explain.信号: Unlike + not…but 双重对比。这句同时挂着两个信号：开头 Unlike many food waste projects 是明示对比，中间 not simply…but… 把真正不同之处推到 but 之后——答案句就 是这种 "对比词 + 转折落点" 叠加的句子。
explain.替换: to provide a high-quality product ↔It aims to provide high-quality products. but 后落点的同义保留
explain.排除: A) 原词陷阱 "size or shape" 出现在 a small part of the production is sometimes wasted due to problems with size or shape——是在解释 "为何会有剩余"，不是公司的产品特点。选项 It pays special attention to the size and shape of its products. 盗用这两个词，编出 "特 别关注尺寸形状" 这个录音没说的差异。 借用原文：wasted due to problems with size or shape B) 过度推断 录音只说它 "不只是再分配废弃食物，而是提供高品质产品"，并没说它要 "摆脱现有食物体 系的束缚"。选项 It tries to escape the constraints of the current food system. 把朴素 的 "提供高品质" 拔高成宏大的体制叙事，是录音支撑不了的引申。 C) 原词陷阱 录音只说她 Talking with local producers I learned that…——只是 "和本地生产者交谈" 从而得知信息，并未说 "紧密合作"。选项 It cooperates closely with local producers. 盗 用 "local producers" 原词，把 "交谈" 夸大成 "closely cooperate"，且这也不是题问的差 异点。 借用原文：Talking with local producers I learned that…

optionsZh: 它特别关注其产品的大小和形状。
它试图摆脱当前食品系统的限制。
它与当地生产商密切合作。
它旨在提供高质量的产品。
options: It pays special attention to the size and shape of its products.
It tries to escape the constraints of the current food system.
It cooperates closely with local producers.
It aims to provide high-quality products.

questions.stem: Why will suppliers always have a certain amount of surplus?
questions.stemZh: 为什么供应商总会有一定数量的剩余?

explain.定位: Perhaps unlike other waste food, the supply is regular. Suppliers will always have a certain amount of surplus. So the menus remain regular too. 也许与其他剩余食物不同，这里的供应是稳定的。供应商总会有一定量的剩余。所以菜单也 保持稳定。
explain.信号: the supply is regular 的因果链。这题的因果不在 "surplus" 那句本身，而在它前面的 the supply is regular——正因要保证 "稳定供应"，所以供应商总会留出一定剩余；"surplus" 那句与 "so the menus remain regular" 共同把 "regular（稳定）" 这条逻辑钉死。
explain.替换: the supply is regular ↔To ensure a regular supply. regular supply 几乎原词对应
explain.排除: B) 原词陷阱 录音说的是 So the menus remain regular too——菜单 "保持稳定（regular）"。选项 To maintain a unique menu. 盗用 "menu" 原词，却把 "regular（稳定）" 偷换成 "unique （独特）"，把听过的词配上录音没说的形容词。 借用原文：So the menus remain regular too C) 原词陷阱 "waste products" 出现在 Elysia uses waste products to create…meals——是说公司 "用 剩余食材做餐"，并非 "供应商留剩余是为弥补废弃"。选项 To make up for the waste products. 盗用 "waste products" 这个主题原词，编出一个录音没有的因果，答非所问。 借用原文：Elysia uses waste products to create "simple, natural, straightforward" meals and snacks D) 未提及 录音通篇没说 "满足顾客的紧急需求"，只讲了供应稳定、菜单稳定。选项 To meet customers' urgent demand. 里的 "urgent demand" 是录音完全没出现的内容，属凭空捏 造。 He's going to take up a full-time position as ambassador for science and space instead—work he's been doing since 2019. 第1段，第2句 本句涵盖主谓宾结构、后置定语(介词短语)、状语、同位语、限制性定语从句(含关系代词省略)等 多种成分,且破折号的使用方式和定语从句的省略现象都是常见易错点,作为成分划分练习具有较高 价值。 What do we learn from the news report about Tim Peake? 第3题题干 特殊疑问句的倒装结构（疑问词 + 助动词 + 主语 + 动词）是四六级听力和阅读中的高频句式， 且"learn from"搭配、介词短语作状语的用法也非常典型。掌握此结构后可大量复用于各类疑问句 分析，代表性较强。 He used to be a helicopter pilot. 第3题，D 主系表结构是基础句式，"used to" 表达过去习惯也是常见考点，具有一定代表性。但句子过于简 短，无复杂修饰或从句，作为典型例句略显单薄，迁移价值中等。 Local newspapers reported that puzzled customers posted on Facebook groups to try to find out if the cat was lost. 第1段，第5句 主句 + that 宾语从句 + 目的状语中嵌套 if 宾语从句，这是典型的书面英语多层嵌套结构，在四六 级和考研阅读中频繁出现。宾语从句和目的状语的组合、if 从句作动词宾语，都是需要反复练习的 常考句式。掌握本句的分析方法后，可以直接迁移到大量类似真题句中，代表性较强。 It just enjoyed visiting the shop. 第1段，第7句 "主语 + 谓语 + 动名词短语作宾语"是常见句式，动名词作宾语在考试中频繁出现，有一定代表 性，但本句过于简单，缺少修饰成分和从句，典型性中等 Staff did their best to discourage the pet from hanging around. 第1段，第8句 简单句 + 不定式目的状语是四六级阅读中的常见句式，do one's best to do sth 也是高频表达；但 因结构过于简单、无从句或特殊句式，作为考研长难句的代表性不足。 But instead of leaving and never coming back, it invited its friends round. 第1段，第9句 句子涵盖主语、谓语、宾语、方式状语（介词短语和副词）等多种成分；介词短语作状语且内部包 含并列结构，可以训练学生识别非谓语动词与谓语动词的区别、介词短语的作用、以及副词状语的 位置；成分种类较丰富 They visit the store so much that staff have been forced to put up signs, asking their customers not to feed them. 第1段，第11句 本句的"so ... that ..."结果状语从句结构是四六级和考研英语中的高频句式，被动语态、现在完成 时、不定式和分词短语的组合也是真题中常见的语法点叠加模式。掌握本句的分析方法可以直接迁 移到大量类似的考试句子，典型性很高。 They are known for their loyalty to their owners. 第5题，A "主语 + be known for + 名词短语" 是四六级和考研阅读中常见的被动语态句式，用于描述事物的 特征或声誉，具有一定的典型性和复用价值。 They are pets kept by the store staff. 第5题，D 主系表结构 + 过去分词短语作后置定语是四六级和考研阅读中的高频句式，尤其在描述事物性质 或状态时常见。此句型简洁且实用，学生掌握后可迁移至大量类似句子（如 "The book written by him is popular"）。虽然本句本身较简单，但其结构模式具有较强的代表性。 It might have been abandoned by its owner. 第6题，B 这种表示“对过去可能性推测”的被动句式在四六级和考研阅读中非常常见，具有很强的复用性。 It might have got lost. 第6题，D 情态动词+完成式结构(表示对过去的推测)是四六级和考研阅读、完形填空中的常见句式,尤其在推 理判断类题目中频繁出现。'get+形容词/过去分词'作系动词用法也是高频考点。掌握本句结构后, 学生可迁移至大量类似表达,如'must have done''could have been'等,具有较强的典型性。 M: Hmm… I don't know if that's a good idea as your mother and I would worry about you living all by yourself in an apartment so far from home. 第2段，第1句 本句覆盖了主语、谓语、宾语（包括宾语从句）、表语、状语从句等多种成分，且包含动名词复合 结构作宾语的特殊用法，适合练习复杂宾语和从句识别。 Have you factored those in? 第4段，第3句 涵盖主谓宾基本成分,且包含短语动词的拆分识别(factor in被宾语隔开),以及疑问句语序下的成分定 位,对掌握动词短语和特殊语序有一定练习价值 It sounds like you'll be wasting several hours every day on the road instead of studying. 第6段，第2句 It sounds like 结构在口语和书面语中都很常见，表语从句是考试高频考点。将来进行时虽不如一般 将来时常见，但也属于标准时态用法。整体句式具有较强的代表性，学生掌握后可迁移到类似的 It seems/appears/looks like 等结构。 After all, I did that during high school and my commute was even longer then. 第7段，第2句 并列句是常考句式,but/and 连接两个主句的结构在四六级和考研阅读中频繁出现。本句可以作为识 别并列连词、区分并列主句与简单并列成分的入门例句。但句子本身过于简单,缺少并列结构常见 的省略、倒装等变化,代表性中等。 But I'm not sure why you want to leave campus and go through all that trouble when the cost is the same. 第8段，第2句 句子结构高度典型：主句 + 宾语从句 + 状语从句的嵌套是四六级和考研阅读中的常见句式，"why you want to..." 的疑问词引导宾语从句和 "when..." 时间状语从句都是高频结构，掌握后可大量复用 于理解类似复合句。 We'd have a kitchen, so we could cook ourselves. 第9段，第2句 "so" 引导结果或目的状语从句是常见句式,虚拟语气也是考试常考点。句子结构具有一定代表性,学 习后可迁移到类似的因果或目的表达中。 What does the man suggest the woman take into consideration? 第9题题干 本句涵盖主谓宾基本成分，同时包含宾语从句的完整结构（从句主语、谓语、宾语、状语），且疑 问词在句中充当从句宾语并前置，展示了疑问句中的特殊语序。虚拟语气的使用为时态语气判断提 供了练习点。此外，take into consideration这一固定搭配中的状语划分也有训练价值。这些特点使 本句成为较好的成分划分练习材料。 I've never heard of it, but I do know little Lawrence loves cartoons. 第7段，第2句 句子展示了but连接的并列转折结构和宾语从句嵌套,这两种都是四六级和考研真题中高频出现的句 式。并列转折用于对比观点或信息,宾语从句用于表达认知、陈述、相信等内容,都是考试阅读和写 作中的典型结构。掌握这类句式后可以迁移到大量类似句子的理解和构造中,代表性强 It has been around since the 1930s. 第10段，第3句 主系表结构配合现在完成时和 since 引导的时间状语，是四六级和考研阅读中常见的基础句式，具 有一定代表性，但过于简单、不涉及从句或并列，典型性中等。 It always reminds people of times of war. 第15题，B 涵盖主谓宾和两个状语（频率状语 "always" 与介词短语状语 "of times of war"），成分种类较为基 础但有一定练习价值，尤其是 "remind sb of sth" 的固定搭配结构值得初学者熟悉。 We assume that if we offer our customers more choices, then they'll be more likely to buy our products. 第1段，第1句 本句是典型的"认为/假设类动词+宾语从句，宾语从句内含条件状语从句"结构，在四六级和考研阅 读中极为常见。assume/think/believe等动词后接that从句，且从句内部再嵌套if/when等状语从句 的句式，是议论文和说明文的高频结构，掌握后可大量复用到类似句型的理解中。 In an extensive study published in 2015, researchers analyzed a total of 99 choice studies and questions.passage:
A) Freshly juiced fruit has become a basic dietary item—especially for busy, health-conscious consumers who can save time on making (and perhaps even chewing) their food without missing out on nutrients. Fruit juice also has been linked to claims that it can help you both lose weight and stay healthy. All of which, of course, has made it highly profitable. The global fruit and vegetable juices market was valued at $154 billion in 2016 and is expected to grow.
B) But is juicing really as healthy as we think? Most foods containing fructose—a naturally occurring sugar found in all fruits and fruit juices—don't seem to have harmful effects as long as they're not contributing to excess daily calories. This is because the fibre found in whole fruits is intact, and the sugar is contained within the fruit's cells. It takes our digestive system a while to break these cells down and for fructose to enter the bloodstream.
C) But this is not the case with fruit juice. Unlike whole fruit, fruit juice has most of the fibre removed. This is why the fructose in fruit juices counts as 'free sugars'—which also include honey and the sugars added to foods. It's recommended by the World Health Organisation that adults have no more than 30g of added sugar, the equivalent of 150ml of fruit juice, per day. The problem is that, with the fibre removed, fruit juice's fructose is absorbed more quickly. Sudden increases in blood sugar cause the release of insulin( 胰岛素) to bring it back down to a stable level. Over time, this mechanism can wear out, increasing the risk of developing type 2 diabetes. In 2013, researchers analysed the health data of 100,000 people collected between 1986 and 2009 and found that fruit juice consumption was linked with increased risk of type 2 diabetes. Another study found a relationship between fruit juice and type 2 diabetes after following the diets and diabetes status of more than 70,000 nurses over 18 years. The researchers explain that the possible reason for this may partly have been the lack of the other components found in whole fruit, like fibre.
D) Juices containing vegetables can provide more nutrients and less sugar than juices made up of just fruit—but they still lack valuable fibre. Diets high in fibre have been linked to a lower risk of developing heart disease, stroke, high blood pressure and diabetes, and it's recommended adults consume 30g per day.
E) Aside from the link to type 2 diabetes, many studies agree that fruit juice is harmful if it contributes to an excess in calories. In an analysis of 155 studies, John Sievenpiper, associate professor at the University of Toronto's Department of Nutritional Sciences, set out to understand if the associations between sugary soft drinks and health—including risk of diabetes and heart disease—were applicable to the food and drink we generally consume as part of a healthy diet. He compared studies looking into the effects of fructose-containing sugars with control diets free from or lower in these sugars. His aim? To isolate the effects of consuming too many calories from the effects of foods containing different sugars.
F) He found negative effects on blood sugar and insulin levels when food provided excess calories from sugars, including fruit juice. However, when the calories weren't in excess overall, there were some advantages to consuming whole fruit—and even fruit juice. Sievenpiper concludes that the recommended 150ml of fruit juice per day, which is an average serving, is reasonable. The paper concluded that foods containing fructose may have some small benefits for long-term blood sugar control when they don't lead to over-consumption of calories. But when they do lead to too many calories, they risk raising blood sugar and insulin levels.
G) So while we know that fruit juice can cause diabetes if it's part of a diet that has more calories overall, it's less clear how juice affects the long-term health of those who aren't overweight. But we have a higher risk of consuming more than the recommended daily number of calories (around 2,000 for women and 2,500 for men) on the days we drink juice, according to research. Numerous studies have shown that drinking fruit juice doesn't make us consume any less of other foods throughout the day.

questions.passage:
A) Freshly juiced fruit has become a basic dietary item—especially for busy, health-conscious consumers who can save time on making (and perhaps even chewing) their food without missing out on nutrients. Fruit juice also has been linked to claims that it can help you both lose weight and stay healthy. All of which, of course, has made it highly profitable. The global fruit and vegetable juices market was valued at $154 billion in 2016 and is expected to grow.
B) But is juicing really as healthy as we think? Most foods containing fructose—a naturally occurring sugar found in all fruits and fruit juices—don't seem to have harmful effects as long as they're not contributing to excess daily calories. This is because the fibre found in whole fruits is intact, and the sugar is contained within the fruit's cells. It takes our digestive system a while to break these cells down and for fructose to enter the bloodstream.
C) But this is not the case with fruit juice. Unlike whole fruit, fruit juice has most of the fibre removed. This is why the fructose in fruit juices counts as 'free sugars'—which also include honey and the sugars added to foods. It's recommended by the World Health Organisation that adults have no more than 30g of added sugar, the equivalent of 150ml of fruit juice, per day. The problem is that, with the fibre removed, fruit juice's fructose is absorbed more quickly. Sudden increases in blood sugar cause the release of insulin( 胰岛素) to bring it back down to a stable level. Over time, this mechanism can wear out, increasing the risk of developing type 2 diabetes. In 2013, researchers analysed the health data of 100,000 people collected between 1986 and 2009 and found that fruit juice consumption was linked with increased risk of type 2 diabetes. Another study found a relationship between fruit juice and type 2 diabetes after following the diets and diabetes status of more than 70,000 nurses over 18 years. The researchers explain that the possible reason for this may partly have been the lack of the other components found in whole fruit, like fibre.
D) Juices containing vegetables can provide more nutrients and less sugar than juices made up of just fruit—but they still lack valuable fibre. Diets high in fibre have been linked to a lower risk of developing heart disease, stroke, high blood pressure and diabetes, and it's recommended adults consume 30g per day.
E) Aside from the link to type 2 diabetes, many studies agree that fruit juice is harmful if it contributes to an excess in calories. In an analysis of 155 studies, John Sievenpiper, associate professor at the University of Toronto's Department of Nutritional Sciences, set out to understand if the associations between sugary soft drinks and health—including risk of diabetes and heart disease—were applicable to the food and drink we generally consume as part of a healthy diet. He compared studies looking into the effects of fructose-containing sugars with control diets free from or lower in these sugars. His aim? To isolate the effects of consuming too many calories from the effects of foods containing different sugars.
F) He found negative effects on blood sugar and insulin levels when food provided excess calories from sugars, including fruit juice. However, when the calories weren't in excess overall, there were some advantages to consuming whole fruit—and even fruit juice. Sievenpiper concludes that the recommended 150ml of fruit juice per day, which is an average serving, is reasonable. The paper concluded that foods containing fructose may have some small benefits for long-term blood sugar control when they don't lead to over-consumption of calories. But when they do lead to too many calories, they risk raising blood sugar and insulin levels.
G) So while we know that fruit juice can cause diabetes if it's part of a diet that has more calories overall, it's less clear how juice affects the long-term health of those who aren't overweight. But we have a higher risk of consuming more than the recommended daily number of calories (around 2,000 for women and 2,500 for men) on the days we drink juice, according to research. Numerous studies have shown that drinking fruit juice doesn't make us consume any less of other foods throughout the day.
H) As it is easy to consume large amounts of fruit juice quite quickly, extra calories are taken in. And extra calories can contribute to weight gain. One way we can improve the effects of fruit juice on our health is making sure we select ripe fruit to retain as much of its goodness as possible, according to Roger Clemens, professor of pharmaceutical( 药物的) sciences at the University of Southern California.
I) Another reason for fruit juice's recent popularity is the argument that it can help to remove poisonous or harmful substances from the body. However, "the whole concept of a juice diet helping to remove poisonous or harmful substances from the body is completely false," says Clemens. "We consume compounds every day that may be poisonous and our bodies do a wonderful job of removing and eliminating anything harmful from our bodies."

questions.passage:
P1 We all take a little extra effort to look nice for special occasions. But most of us have conflicting feelings about dressing up and feel guilty about taking the time to focus on clothes. Science now suggests the right dress may give ourselves the extra edge in our professional and personal lives.

P2 We hear sayings like "dress for the job you want; not the job you have". Most people don't really believe in them, but research into the impact of clothes on behavior now suggests that there may actually be a grain of truth in these sayings. Science says that the clothes we wear affect our behavior, our mood and even the way we interact with others because of the symbolic meaning that we assign to different types of clothing.

P3 We consider some clothes to be powerful, some to be fun, and so on. We even evaluate people whom we have just met based on their clothes. We also evaluate ourselves based on what we are wearing because of the way they make us feel. This means that the experience of wearing something affects our attitudes and our choice of behavior.

P4 There's a reason tailored jackets are associated with being 'dressed for success'. It seems that wearing formal office wear puts us in the right frame of mind to conduct business. Wearing power clothing makes us feel more confident and even increases hormones needed for displaying dominance. This in turn helps us become better negotiators and abstract thinkers.

P5 While a good suit works wonders for our performance in the boardroom, wearing formal wear isn't a great idea when we want to socialize. Studies have found that people tend to be less open and less able to relax when they wear formal clothes.

P6 On the other hand, a casual dress helps us become more friendly and creative. These findings support the idea of wearing business casuals on a Friday; since colleagues are most likely to take out time to socialize on the last work day of the week. I mean, who wants to hang out with people in their suits?

P1 We all take a little extra effort to look nice for special occasions. But most of us have conflicting feelings about dressing up and feel guilty about taking the time to focus on clothes. Science now suggests the right dress may give ourselves the extra edge in our professional and personal lives.

P2 We hear sayings like "dress for the job you want; not the job you have". These findings support the idea of wearing business casuals on a Friday; since colleagues are most likely to take out time to socialize on the last work day of the week. questions.passage:
P1 With the rise of pop music, jazz, and electronic music, both opera and classical music started to fade away from the public eye. Some people are beginning to wonder whether opera and classical music are still relevant to the modern world of music. Granted, you will not typically see today's teenagers lending their ears to Bach anytime soon, but there are some major indicators that both opera and classical music are now still quite alive.

P2 The most major indicator of classical music's importance in society today is the fact that much of the popular music that is currently being produced uses similar beats, harmonies, and melodies(旋律) as those that were used in some of classical music's best works. Even so, it can be difficult for those who do not study music theory to see this as an indicator, since it is subtle and just shows the impact symphonic(交响乐的) orchestras have had on society's taste in music.

P3 A better example for the relevance of opera and classical music can be seen in the invention of the rock opera. Opera, in its simplest definition, is telling a story using music as its form. The art of telling a story using music has not faded in the least bit. In fact, sometimes actual orchestras are used for major parts of the opera itself. Some of the world's greatest hits have been parts of rock operas.

P4 Fans of classical music can also tell you that there are few types of music that are more expressive. So, it should come as no surprise to anyone that classical music pieces are still used as background music in modern movies. Symphonic orchestra compositions have also been created solely for the purpose of being included in major motion pictures. These are often very well received amongst mainstream music fans.

P5 Classical music and opera are the very foundation of what our modern music is based upon. Considering the huge impact they have had on our current society, it is without doubt that we can expect them to continue to remain important for centuries to come.

writing.directions: Suppose your university is conducting a survey to collect students' opinions on the appropriate use of AI technology in assisting learning. You are now to write an essay to express your view. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
writing.model: In my view, AI technology, when used appropriately, is a valuable ally in learning rather than a shortcut that replaces genuine effort. Since our university is surveying students on this issue, I would like to voice my support for embracing AI in a sensible, balanced way. There are solid reasons for this position. First, AI tools raise learning efficiency: a chatbot can explain a confusing grammar point instantly, check my essay for mistakes, or gather background material that once took hours in the library. Second, AI offers personalized tutoring, adjusting its explanations to my own pace and weak spots. Admittedly, however, over-reliance is a real danger; if students let AI think for them, their own analytical skills will gradually wither. Therefore, the key lies in "appropriate" use. We should treat AI as an assistant that guides and inspires, not a machine that hands us ready-made answers. Used within this boundary, AI can truly make learning smarter.
writing.modelZh: 【参考译文】在我看来，只要使用得当，人工智能技术就是学习中的得力伙伴，而不是替代真正努力的捷径。既然我们学校正就这一问题向学生征集意见，我愿表达自己的支持——以理性、平衡的方式拥抱AI。持这一立场有充分的理由。首先，AI工具能提升学习效率：聊天机器人能即刻讲清一个绕人的语法点，帮我检查作文里的错误，或者找来过去要在图书馆花上几个小时才能找到的背景资料。其次，AI能提供个性化辅导，按我自己的节奏和薄弱环节来调整它的讲解。不过，必须承认，过度依赖是真实存在的危险；如果学生让AI替自己思考，他们自身的分析能力就会逐渐退化。因此，关键在于「合理」使用。我们应把AI当作引导和启发我们的助手，而不是直接递给我们现成答案的机器。在这条边界之内使用，AI才能真正让学习变得更聪明。【第 1 段】两句完成表态与扣题。首句 In my view... rather than a shortcut 用「亮明观点」句架一句站队，第二句 Since our university is surveying students... 用「回应语境」句架接住调查背景，落实了表态段「亮立场＋点价值」的功能。【第 2 段】分点举例加让步显辩证。There are solid reasons 领起后，First / Second 切出效率与个性化两条理由，explain... check... or gather 用「举例落地」把好处具象化；Admittedly, however, over-reliance is a real danger 用「让步转折」补上风险，正扣 appropriate 的边界感。【第 3 段】回扣题眼并划边界收口。Therefore, the key lies in "appropriate" use 用「回扣题眼」把落点钉回核心词，an assistant... not a machine 给出具体边界，末句 Used within this boundary... 升华作结，与开头立场首尾呼应。

outline.text: 两句完成表态与扣题。首句 In my view... rather than a shortcut 用「亮明观点」句架一句 站队，第二句 Since our university is surveying students... 用「回应语境」句架接住调查背景，落实了 表态段「亮立场＋点价值」的功能。
分点举例加让步显辩证。There are solid reasons 领起后，First / Second 切出效率与个性 化两条理由，explain... check... or gather 用「举例落地」把好处具象化；Admittedly, however, over- reliance is a real danger 用「让步转折」补上风险，正扣 appropriate 的边界感。
回扣题眼并划边界收口。Therefore, the key lies in "appropriate" use 用「回扣题眼」把落 点钉回核心词，an assistant... not a machine 给出具体边界，末句 Used within this boundary... 升华 作结，与开头立场首尾呼应。

translation.directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to translate a passage from Chinese into English. You should write your answer on Answer Sheet 2.
translation.source: 近年来,中国东北地区正在大力开发冰雪资源。例如,哈尔滨利用丰富的冰雪资源打造了极具地方特色的"冰雪大世界",让游客在欣赏冰雪之美的同时也能体验当地独特的民俗文化。如今,曾令人畏惧的冰天雪地正吸引着四面八方的游客,成为深受欢迎的旅游胜地。冰雪旅游业正为当地的经济发展做出越来越大的贡献。
translation.reference: In recent years, Northeast China has been vigorously developing its ice and snow resources. For example, Harbin has built the Ice and Snow World with strong local characteristics by making full use of its rich ice and snow resources, allowing tourists to experience the unique local folk culture while enjoying the beauty of ice and snow. Today, the once-feared land of ice and snow is attracting tourists from all directions and has become a popular tourist destination. Ice and snow tourism is making an increasingly great contribution to the local economic development.

sentences.trunk: 东北地区(主)+开发(谓)+冰雪资源(宾)（主语策略：原句主语） 中文已有明确主语 中国东北地区，直接作英文主语 Northeast China；核心动词 开发 作谓语 develop；冰雪资源 作宾语 its ice and snow resources。主干即 Northeast China is vigorously developing its ice and snow resources。
sentences.downgrade: 时间状语+程度副词降级安放 主干外只有两个修饰成分：近年来 是时间状语，译成 In recent years 放句首；大力 是程度修饰， 译成副词 vigorously 放在谓语前。本句结构简单，不需要从句或非谓语，按"状语归状语、副词贴 动词"安放即可。
sentences.grammar: 时态 回指全篇基调，但本句"正在大力开发"强调当下持续进行，用现在进行时 is developing 比一般现 在时更贴 正在大力开发 的"正在"义；这是对基调的合理局部偏离。 单复数 resources 用复数："冰雪资源"指成片、多种的资源，不可数化为单数会失"丰富"之意，统一用 ice and snow resources。 时间状语搭配 "近年来"固定搭配 in recent years（recent + years 复数），别误写成 in recent year 或 these years 单独成句。
sentences.target: In recent years, Northeast China has been vigorously developing its ice and snow resources. 2. 例如,哈尔滨利用丰富的冰雪资源打造了极具地方特色的"冰雪大世界",让游客在欣赏冰雪之美 的同时也能体验当地独特的民俗文化。

sentences.trunk: 哈尔滨(主)+打造了(谓)+冰雪大世界(宾)（主语策略：原句主语） 本句最主要的动作是 打造，施动者 哈尔滨 作主语，核心宾语是 "冰雪大世界"。主干立为 Harbin has built the Ice and Snow World。"利用丰富的冰雪资源"和"让游客……"都不是主干，留到下一 步降级。
sentences.downgrade: 其余三个动作分别降级成状语/定语/从句 利用丰富的冰雪资源 降级成介词短语状语 by making use of its rich ice and snow resources； 极具地方特色的 降级成后置定语 with strong local characteristics（贴在 Ice and Snow World 后）；让游客在欣赏冰雪之美的同时也能体验当地独特的民俗文化 降级成 where 引导的定语从句 或 allowing… 非谓语，"在……的同时"用 while 连接 enjoying 与 experiencing 两个动作。整句 不照中文用 and 平铺，而是一主句套若干修饰。
sentences.grammar: 时态 "打造了"是已完成的动作（景区已建成并仍在运营），用现在完成时 has built，对全篇一般现在时 基调的合理偏离；从句内"欣赏、体验"是泛指经常性体验，用一般现在时 enjoy / experience。 单复数与冠词 tourists 用复数（泛指游客群体）；专名前 the Ice and Snow World 加定冠词 the（特指那一个 景区）；民俗文化 local folk culture 作不可数名词，不加 s。 介词搭配 "利用"用 by making use of / by using；"在……的同时"用 while + doing；"体验……文化"用 experience the culture，别搭 feel。 主谓一致 主语 Harbin 是单数第三人称，助动词用 has built；若用 allowing 非谓语则不涉及与主语数的一 致问题。
sentences.target: For example, Harbin has built the Ice and Snow World with strong local characteristics by making full use of its rich ice and snow resources, allowing tourists to experience the unique local folk culture while enjoying the beauty of ice and snow. 3. 如今,曾令人畏惧的冰天雪地正吸引着四面八方的游客,成为深受欢迎的旅游胜地。

sentences.trunk: 冰天雪地(主)+吸引着(谓)+游客(宾)（主语策略：原句主语） 主语是 冰天雪地（the icy and snowy land / world of ice and snow），核心谓语取 吸引着 译 is attracting，宾语 四面八方的游客 即 tourists from all over。"曾令人畏惧的"是修饰主语的定 语、"成为旅游胜地"是并列的结果，均留到下一步处理。
sentences.downgrade: 定语前置+结果并列降级 曾令人畏惧的 是"过去曾……"的定语，降级成 once-feared 前置定语或 which was once feared 定语从句修饰主语；成为深受欢迎的旅游胜地 降级成并列谓语 and has become a popular tourist destination，或用现在分词 becoming…。两处都挂到主语"冰天雪地"上，不另起一句。
sentences.grammar: 时态 "如今正吸引着"用现在进行时 is attracting 扣"正"义；"成为旅游胜地"已发生且持续，用现在完成 时 has become；定语"曾令人畏惧"指过去状态，用 once-feared 或 was once feared 带过去意 味。三处时态分别对应"现在进行/已完成/过去"，是有依据的差异而非随意飘。 今昔对比的措辞 "曾令人畏惧"译 once feared / once daunting，"如今……吸引"用 now / today 起头，靠 once… now… 显出今昔反差，别把"曾"漏译。 单复数与冠词 tourists 复数（四面八方的游客是群体）；a popular tourist destination 加不定冠词 a（成为"一 处"胜地，单数可数名词须带冠词）。
sentences.target: Today, the once-feared land of ice and snow is attracting tourists from all directions and has become a popular tourist destination. 4. 冰雪旅游业正为当地的经济发展做出越来越大的贡献。

sentences.trunk: 冰雪旅游业(主)+做出贡献(谓宾)（主语策略：原句主语） 主语 冰雪旅游业 即 ice and snow tourism；核心动作 做出……贡献 用固定搭配 make a contribution / contribute；对象 当地的经济发展 即 the local economic development。主干立 为 Ice and snow tourism is making contributions to the local economic development。
sentences.downgrade: 程度递增修饰降级成形容词 主干外的修饰只有 越来越大的（修饰"贡献"的程度）和 当地的（修饰"经济发展"）。"越来越大 的"译成 increasingly great / growing 作定语，或用 contribute increasingly to…；"当地的"译 local 作前置定语。本句结构简单，无需从句。
sentences.grammar: 时态 "正……做出"用现在进行时 is making / is contributing 扣"正"的进行义，呼应全篇"正在发生"的基 调。 搭配与介词 "为……做出贡献"固定搭配 make a contribution to sth. / contribute to sth.，介词是 to，别用 for；contribution 作可数名词时常用复数 contributions 表多方面贡献。 单复数与不可数名词 tourism（旅游业）、economic development（经济发展）都是不可数名词，作主语谓语用单数 （is），前面不加 a、不加 s。
sentences.target: Ice and snow tourism is making an increasingly great contribution to the local economic development. 英语四级 2025年6月·第2套 · 全卷构成 Part I 写作 题目解析 → Part II 听力 题目解析 → Part Ⅲ Section A 完形填空（选词填空） 题目解析 → Part Ⅲ Section B 长篇阅读（信息匹配） 题目解析 → Part Ⅲ Section C 阅读理解（四选一） 题目解析 → Part Ⅲ Section C (2) 阅读理解（四选一） 题目解析 → Part IV 汉译英（段落翻译） 本题
